title: Bind auth-mail enqueue placeholders to the exact reviewed PostgreSQL signature
acceptance: auth.enqueue_mail_outbox is called with exactly twelve placeholders bound in reviewed order
the five leading payload fields and the replay/idempotency/correlation fields are explicitly cast to text
the key version and max-attempt positions are explicitly cast to integer
available_at and expires_at are explicitly cast to timestamptz
the focused regression asserts the exact cast order and preserves value positions
no migration, privilege, RLS, reviewer identity, reset, mail, session, runtime or production mutation is introduced
